Under the hood

Four moving parts, every one of them visible in your browser’s network tab.

01

Chain tip

One batched call to a public Solana node asks for the confirmed block height and slot. It repeats every two seconds. The counter estimates forward between answers, then lands on the node’s own figure.

02

Market scan

A DexScreener search runs every thirty seconds. Only Solana pairs survive the filter, and each logo, price and volume figure is passed through untouched.

03

Patient retries

When a source stalls, the pause ahead of each retry doubles up to a ceiling. Tiles flip to a dash with a plain message rather than present stale numbers as fresh.

04

Contract slot

One address bar sits above everything. It is locked today and opens the moment an address is published.
